reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch G3-NA-Q2-Harden (mat_g3_na_q2_4), 2026-08-18

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The sample set fully satisfies the MATATAG learning competency requirement to subtract numbers less than 10 000, both with and without regrouping. Subtraction without regrouping is directly evaluated in items such as 'What is 8413 − 4110?' (seed 43), 'What is 3463 − 60?' (seed 46), and '3377 − 210 = ___' (seed 603). Subtraction with regrouping across multiple place values is robustly assessed in problems such as 'What is 1830 − 1744?' (seed 42), '7222 − 810 = ___' (seed 44), '880 − 102 = ___' (seed 45), 'The total is 6398 and one part is 3715. What is the other part?' (seed 500), and 'What is 5609 − 1839?' (seed 502). All operands are non-negative integers strictly under 10 000, directly fulfilling the core mandate.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The items comprehensively cover the domain by assessing diverse digit combinations (4-digit minus 4-digit, 4-digit minus 3-digit, 4-digit minus 2-digit, 3-digit minus 3-digit, and 2-digit minus 2-digit) and varied degrees of regrouping. Problems span regrouping across tens and ones ('What is 1830 − 1744?', seed 42; '880 − 102 = ___', seed 45; '3418 − 3379 = 39. True or False?', seed 501), regrouping across hundreds and thousands ('7222 − 810 = ___', seed 44; 'What is 5609 − 1839?', seed 502; 'What is 5252 − 1800?', seed 600; 'What is 912 − 570?', seed 602), and non-regrouping cases ('What is 8413 − 4110?', seed 43; 'What is 5325 − 4220?', seed 604). Furthermore, problems evaluate counting backward along a continuum ('The dot is at 7042 and it moves backward 6900 numbers. Starting from 7042, just count back 6900 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?', seed 50) and part-part-whole relationships ('The total is 1389 and one part is 1170. What is the other part?', seed 55).

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The linguistic and structural presentation is developmentally well-calibrated for Grade 3 Quarter 2 learners. Sentences are succinct and avoid excessive syntactic or lexical overhead. Number line concepts are clearly articulated in child-friendly language ('The dot is at 152 and it moves backward 110 numbers. Starting from 152, just count back 110 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?', seed 605), while part-whole reasoning is cleanly structured without ambiguous phrasing ('The total is 6398 and one part is 3715. What is the other part?', seed 500). Word problems present intuitive, everyday contexts ('Pia has 18 water bowls. A friend has 10 water bowls. How many more water bowls does Pia have than the friend?', seed 601) that remain well within early primary reading and cognitive capacity.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The packet exhibits strong pedagogical variety across multiple item archetypes and formatters. It encompasses direct multiple-choice arithmetic ('What is 5609 − 1839?', seed 502; 'What is 912 − 570?', seed 602), standard cloze equation completion ('7222 − 810 = ___', seed 44; '3377 − 210 = ___', seed 603), conceptual movement along a number line ('The dot is at 7042 and it moves backward 6900 numbers. Starting from 7042, just count back 6900 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?', seed 50), error detection diagnosing common place-value misconceptions ('Ana solved: "542 − 20 = ___". Ana says the missing number is 562. Is Ana correct?', seed 51), part-whole relational missing-addend/subtraction items ('The total is 1389 and one part is 1170. What is the other part?', seed 55), true/false identity verification ('903 − 300 = 603. True or False?', seed 85; '3418 − 3379 = 39. True or False?', seed 501), and comparative word problems ('Pia has 18 water bowls. A friend has 10 water bowls. How many more water bowls does Pia have than the friend?', seed 601).

competency_alignment.rationale: All 18 items strictly conform to the exact parameters of mat_g3_na_q2_4. Every minuend and subtrahend is strictly less than 10 000, and minuends are uniformly greater than subtrahends, ensuring differences remain within positive whole numbers. The items focus squarely on subtraction with and without regrouping without straying into out-of-scope operations or premature upper-grade concepts. Items such as 'What is 3463 − 60?' (seed 46) and '3418 − 3379 = 39. True or False?' (seed 501) precisely assess the target computational and conceptual skills.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The numerical scale is tightly bounded within the specified limit (< 10 000) and displays an appropriate distribution across the 100 to 9 999 domain. Minuends reach realistically up to high 4-digit numbers ('What is 8413 − 4110?', seed 43; '7222 − 810 = ___', seed 44; 'The dot is at 7042 and it moves backward 6900 numbers. Starting from 7042, just count back 6900 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?', seed 50; 'The total is 6398 and one part is 3715. What is the other part?', seed 500) while also sampling lower multi-digit numbers ('880 − 102 = ___', seed 45; 'The dot is at 152 and it moves backward 110 numbers. Starting from 152, just count back 110 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?', seed 605). The scale balances mental subtraction across round tens/hundreds with multi-step column regrouping across 4-digit values.
